nom: Kiehl's Since 1851 Facial Fuel Energizing Scrub for Men

avis.texte: It goes on so creamy and nourishing, but dries down when washing it off. Works so great on my beard to stop shaving bumps after I trim it.
hands down may be my favorite face scrub. honestly no words for this - if you haven't tried it, buy it.

avis.titre: Works for teenage and adult skin
avis.texte: I started by now 30+ year old sons on this product when they were teenagers to help with breakout prone skin. They have used it ever since.

Omg, I bought this for my husband and loved it more than any of my face scrubs. I end up using most of it. I also used it on my body, it's amazing! This is the best way to wake up your skin in the morning. Looking forward to try more of the "Fuel" line.

One of the best exfoliating washes on the market! Don't get me wrong, I used to use Clean and Clear's exfoliating scrub for the price and easy drug store convenience, but it would scrape my face and leave it dry. THIS IS THE STUFF!! Worth every penny and it smells pretty luxurious. Basically if you love the Facial Fuel line, then you'll love this. I use every 2-3 days.
I love this minty scrub, it leaves my face feeling super clean and minty fresh!!
Great exfoliator for a pre-shave routine. Very light but pleasing citrus scent.
Used it for the first time and my skin felt great. there was an instant invigorating feeling and after I moisturized it feels like the hydration is getting sucked in.
My routine includes a once or maybe twice weekly use of facial scrub
Really like the feel of this soap. I like the clean minty finish.
Better than st. Ives apricot scrub or blackhead scrub. The smell, the scrub, the sudsing action..it's everything that st. Ives isn't. Or everything it should be.
Perfect. Scrubs well. Rinses off clean. Smells nice. Coarse enough to get results yiu can see and feel but gentle enough to use daily.
This scrub has the perfect size granule and does such a great job on my skin. I use it 2-:X a week for about 2 minutes each time. Fantastic exfoliation without being too much.

avis.titre: Facial Fuel Scrub wakes you up! Better than coffee
avis.texte: Love Facial Fuel, the best exfoliating scrub around! Great smell! Squeaky clean skin, wakes you up better than coffee, highly recommended for people who have a problem waking up in the morning for a long commute into work! Hehe, this is the way to start your day! Soft clean skin, great scent, not too strong, just right. Only natural and top quality ingredients used!
Great smell and feel. So glad I bought this. Wake up in the shower
Skin feels clean, refreshed and ready for a shave. Had a great lather and scrub is not too course.
Use twice weekly and it makes my face feel terrific. Give a nice clean look.

It's a great scrub. Leaves you feeling squeaky clean and tight. Over the years, I've looked far and wide, testing whatever I could find. But Kiehl's Facial Fuel Scrub is best out there. It helps when I'm facially in trouble or when things are just right.
Great product but, need to improve availability of the larger 5oz size.

Perfect balance of scrubbiness while still being gentle. Fresh clean scent that isn't overwhelming. The tube package superior to tubs. Can keep in shower without getting water in it. Please never discontinue.
I been using Facial Fuel for more than 10 years it's my favorite moisturizer very light and effective with sun protection. It's the best moisturizer out there !!

avis.titre: You need Facial Fuel Scrub - I promise!
avis.texte: Great product for exfoliating your skin, leaving it feeling clean and refreshed.
This irritated my skin and after I use and go out in the sun (even with SPF 50) my face gets sunburned and more irritated.
Purchased this to add to the Facial Fuel Bundle which included a blue toiletry bag.
It renews my skin with a gentle scrub. I use it several times a week.
This is a must scrub for face and does not dry out skin, a little bit goes a long way.

avis.titre: This Unisex Facial Scrub is our go to scrub
avis.texte: My boyfriend initially purchased this scrub but I end up using it as much as he does!
I swear by Kiehl's face products and now have my husband using and loving this scrub.

avis.titre: All other brands fail in comparison to Kiehl's!!!!
avis.texte: Great product! Will continue to purchase. Please do not discontinue.

avis.titre: I've tried them all - this is the best!
avis.texte: Over the past ten years I've experimented with every men's scrub and found this to be the best. It doesn't have a chemical smell and feels very natural. It is course enough to really scrub and open up the pores - other brands feel very granular / small and smell like like chemicals Pro tip - use this before you shave to get the hairs to really stand up on your face for a close shave
I have been you this for years and it does a great cleaning my face.

avis.titre: Facial Fuel Scrub Refreshes and Invigorates
avis.texte: I'm a committed customer. Facial Fuel Scrub invigorates my skin, gently exfoliates and holds age back a bit. Friends have even asked why I look so "refreshed" in the morning now!
By far the best scrub to use prior to shaving . Highly recommended.
This facial fuel scrub is absolutely amazing. Very pleased with the consistency and texture. When they were sold out I thought I was going to lose my mind!!
I love using this before I shave. It makes the whole process much easier.
I love this scrub! Mix just a little with your cleanser in the shower for a deep clean. Great before shaving! And not plastic microbeads to pollute the oceans.

Kiehl's is one of if not the best facial scrub I have used. The granularity (if that's a word) is even and abundant. My face afterwards demonstrates how effective the scrub is. The grit and grime, etc., is effectively removed. My skin feels clean, refreshed, invigorated. I know this sounds like a commercial. Love the product. I have been a Kiehl's customer for over fifty years. That's the truth and my endorsement is my attendance over the years.

avis.titre: Pack Products well Before Sending in Mail.
avis.texte: I'm not commenting on this product until someone addresses ALL of issues relating how products are not packed well in boxes sent through the mail. I have received several packages that have not been packed appropriately so the products break open.

One of my favorites, when I want an invigorating cleanse this is the one. Its scrubby and minty, smells great without being too masculine. I use this several times a week for a great exfoliation, Kiehl's is the best!

I've been using this for a couple years now, except a couple months when it was out of stock and let me tell you, that sucked. I'd say I have combination skin but exta dry in the winter. This product works better than any other face wash or scrub I've used. It takes and the tough/stubborn dry skin off leaving my face looking and feeling smooth, refreshed, and pores smaller. I hope the price stays the same and it stays in stock, this will continue to be my only face scrub I buy.
Great product and great customer service. I have been using this product for many years and wouldn't use anything else.
It is gentle while doing a deep cleansing job. I particularly recommend it for men.

avis.titre: My go to before shaving or after exercising!
avis.texte: I like to use this scrub before shaving or after exercising! It seems to clear the pores, smooth the skin, and leave a refreshing matte finish. Be careful not to overuse, it can dry the skin.
Best product ever! An integral part of my shaving routine for years.
One of the only products found in my search that manages ingrown facial hairs. Provided it's a frequent problem for me this exfoliant is IT!!
Great scrub before shaving to prep hair and skin for a smooth shave

This is a top notch product that I always want to have on hand. It's not so tough that I can't use it back to back days, but it also does a phenomenal job of getting rid of dead skin that flakes off through my beard. The only reason I'm not giving it five stars is that the formula seems to change fairly often. A size of the large tube can last me a year and when I go to re-order it again there's always something that's just a little different the last couple years. It has more of a sand quality now which is so heavy it doesn't actually go down the drain. It's minor because the results are still great but I think something to be aware of if you're considering this product.
Awesome scrub to use before shaving! Been using it for many years please don't ever discontinue this product!

I believe the formula was changed. It's much lighter color, doesn't smell like before. Before it was more orange and minty smell, now it doesn't have the same refreshing & awakening qualities. It was perfect for my morning routine. Disappointed since I bought two tubes of it.

avis.titre: Didn't realize it was for men. Oops
avis.texte: I bought it for myself, not realizing it was for men. I use it about once a week in my skincare routine and I think it does great exfoliating and freshening my skin!

THE PEOPLE HAVE SPOKEN AND WE HATE THIS FORMULA. I JUST BOUGHT 6 TUBES AND AFTER SEEING THE AMOUNT OF PEOPLE COMPLAINING ABOUT HOW KIEHLS DECIDED TO FIX A PROBLEM THAT WASN'T BROKEN AND HOW THE NEW FORMULA IS "MORE OF A FACE WASH THAN A SCRUB", I'M GETTING A REFUND.

Most Kiehl's products are exceptional, I have been using them for over 15 years. The Facial Fuel Energy Scrub is not an exception, this is phenomenal face scrub for man, most others on the market are not as effective. The only one which is competitive is from La Mer. However, at higher price point and it is not really better. Your face will feel amazing, cleaned thoroughly, this scrub is not harsh to you face. I recommend as a part of your twice a week regimen. Your face will thank you.

avis.titre: The best product that is no longer available!!!
avis.texte: This product changed my 15 yr. old sons life. We are devastated it is no longer available.

avis.titre: It's basically St. Ives apricot scrub...
avis.texte: The ingredients in this are horrible and I can't believe anyone idea this...
Why change something that didn't need changing. It's more a face wash than a scrub now. It's less gritty and it's a face wash now. Disappointing!!

The formula was updated without any indication from the site. It is a whiter color, doesn't smell as good (in my opinion), and the texture has been altered, it seems to be creamier now. It is okay, but it's unfortunate, since the product was so good as it was. It also should be expected that if the formula changes, the marketing and website should release that information, especially considering the prices.

avis.titre: If it isn't broke, don't fix it.
avis.texte: For some reason, Kiehl's decided to turn this into a more creamy product with a completely different scent. It is now barely a scrub.

avis.titre: Used to Be the best pre shave scrub
avis.texte: I've been using Kiehl's since 1978 when I used to shop at 14th Street in while in High School. Many different product lines over the years. The facial fuel line for the past 15 or so years has been outstanding and best in class. Unfortunately, they discontinued the after shave. To add further insult someone made the decision to drastically change the quality of the scrub. It is now a touch better than your drugstore scrubs but with a hefty price tag. Way more cream than scrub. I'll be bailing on the scrub and searching for the hits and misses out in the retail world. Save your hard earned money or waste it to concur with my review.

I use this before I shave. The methanol definitely makes this an energizing (as well as cooling) scrub. The scrub is also sort of gritty, but you can tell it is really exfoliating the skin. It also makes my face glow a bit after use.

I absolutely love this product. Usually use it every time I will be shaving, but the scent is great, not to overpowering, at least for me that is. I really feel it cleans, and after my shaving routine, I just make sure to moisturize, it can leave your face a bit dry. Definitely recommend.

I received a sample of this product and that allowed 2-3 uses. I used the product and really saw benefits of soft, smooth, healthier, brighter skin. I will definitely be ordering a full size of this product and adding it to my weekly regimen. Using it in combination with the Daily Reviving and Midnight Recovery Concentrates is awesome. Seems to make your face really absorb (take in) the oils. Love this product, it's been hard to find a facial scrub that doesn't have a greasy feel that's hard to wash off or remove when finished using.
I've used this scrub once before it feels pretty missing really cleans out your press not over drying the skin.

avis.titre: my take on Kiehl's Facial fuel energizing scrub
avis.texte: Recently, i bought this product, among many other men's products, And i had to share with everyone that this is my favorite out of all the many brands i've tried i'm picky and this gets a 5.
Best Men?s exfoliator. Just buy this. It is amazing. Add to you cart and buy it.

This scrub is one of my favorite Kiehls products. Nothing has ever made my face feel so clean. Great to use to get a deep clean before using a moisturizer or Midnight Recovery Concentrate. Definitely a must have in your Kiehls product line.
The facial fuel scrub is amazing great texture, you can feel it whisking away the grime on the face. Great product
My husband loves this product. He loves to use the scrub right before shaving to get a nice close shave. He follows up with the moisturizer to lock it all in for a soft, smooth face.
I tried this at a friend's house and had to buy it for myself! Feels like it is totally refreshing your skin and cleaning out your pores.

This is a great skin buffer. I use it to wash my face once weekly, usually right before I use the Rare Earth Face Mask to maximize results. It is important to note that the texture is very thick and gritty, and a little goes a long way. While the smell is not as pleasant as other products in the Facial Fuel line, it goes away after a few seconds and can be overlooked due to the positive results it yields. This is a great scrub if your skin is looking dull. It will brighten and remove impurities instantly. Highly recommend!
This facial scrub is amazing! My face actually feels like it gets a surge of energy every time I use it. My skin glows and feels fantastic - I definitely recommend!
I bought the face wash, scrub, moisturizer because it's a good line.

Bought this for my husband for Xmas a few years ago and ended up trying it myself. We both adore it- it's great for his oily skin and preventing ingrown hairs from shaving, great at balancing my combination skin. It contains no propylene glycol, which is a huge plus in my book (ladies' products contain this ingredient, which is a skin irritant that causes me to have bouts of dermatitis and, with repeated use of offending products, hives....not fun at all!). Since I started using this, my skin has been clear and smooth.... I get compliments all the time. Love the cooling effect too... definitely a "male marketed" product, but honestly... If you share this with the ladies in your life, I bet they'll eventually add it to their daily routines as well after seeing the results. Awesome for everyone! Hope this product, as currently formulated, remains on the market indefinitely. It's a WINNER!

I absolutely love this product. I'm really big in to face scrubs, I feel like it controls my acne outbreaks and cleans out pores to stop them from getting blocked and breaking out. I use the scrub about three times a week, every other day or so. I use it before I shave and it helps get rid of the dead skins and refresh my face. I also use it if I've had a lot of sunscreen on my face or double layers of sunscreen as it clears out your pores effectively. I don't like face scrubs where the beads melt away- and this product is perfect as the scrubbing beads stick around and allow you to really exfoliate the beard area. Great value, scent and very effective. I keep the large tube around at all times and it lasts a long time too. Use the Facial Fuel cleanser and toner afterwards for a perfect combo.
Too bad they're not manufacturing it any longer. Why, you ask, would they keep it on the website rather than remove it? Good question. Kiehl's?

Not just for men!! I have suffered from acne for most of my life, and have tried all different types of products and treatments and nothing seemed to work permanently. Then I discovered Kiehl's. I started using this scrub about six months ago, and it has cleared up my acne completely. I am truly grateful for this product.

I'm not one to usually use scrubs, but this one has been one of the exceptions due to how amazing the product is. As all scrubs I'd suggest using once your skin is moist from warm water. I also suggest rubbing a small amount on your skin, lightly, in a circular motion until satisfied. Probably best to only use this a few times a week. Again, although this is labeled for men - Women can, and are encouraged to, use this product

This is the best scrub I've ever used. Not too rough but with the prefect texture for exfoliating. Gentle enough for daily use! I highly suggest this if you're looking for something to keep oil at bay, minimize breakouts, and keep skin radiant!

This scrub is by far one of the best I have ever used. It scrubs off dead skin and leaves my skin feeling so smooth! I can also feel my facial hair soften, leaving my face prepared for a comfortable shave.

This scrub lets you know it working. There is generous grit with a pleasant scent. My face feels very smooth after without being dried out. I use it at night instead of before a shave, as I don't like the idea of scrubbing my skin too hard before a shave that already irritates my face.

avis.titre: Just the right amount of grit
avis.texte: Some scrubs seem to have very little "scrub". This one is great. Plenty of grit. Lathers nicely at the same time so no need to use a wash product afterward. Great scent. It's a keeper.

This is the best scrub I've used in a long time, mostly because you don't need to moisturize your face afterward. I have really oily/combo skin, and this really keeps oil at a minimum for the majority of the day. My day usually begins at 8am and I don't get done with everything until around 8-10pm. I'd say this face wash keeps the oils balanced up until around 7pm. It lasts that long! I've also noticed my skin tone improving and no acne present. I know the labels say to use this very minimally, but I use this every morning and I'm good to go. This is so-far my favorite scrub ever. A little bit on the pricier side, but so worth it for me and my skin.

I love this scrub! I have combination-oily skin and this scrub really makes my face feel clean and energized. I use this product twice a week and have noticed a difference in the overall clarity of my skin. I would highly recommend this product to men of all skin types.

I have tried many products to help clean my face after shaving but Facial Fuel is the only product that really makes my face feel truly clean and refreshed! You only need a little to get the perfect scrub and wash!
Got this as a sample 4 years ago and have been using it ever since.
I love using this product in the shower before shaving. Prepares my face well. I use it every other day and love it.

avis.titre: AMAZING PRODUCT!!! A "MUST HAVE" FOR GUYS WITH SENSITIVE ...
avis.texte: I'm in my 40s and have very sensitive skin. I hate to shave, and my face hates it even more! For all of my life, I've always gotten little white shaving bumps on my face, usually within about 24 hours of shaving. And for all my life, I've been in search of the "perfect" pre-shave, shaving cream/lotion, and razor. And FINALLY I found the most amazing pre-shave product on the market... Kiehl's Facial Fuel Energizing Scrub Skin Buffer for Men!!! Now that I'm using this scrub right before shaving, I pretty much never get any shaving bumps, and it really helps me get a closer and more comfortable shave. This product is truly amazing, and definitely worth every penny!!!
I have used several facial scrubs before but none have ever worked as good as this one does. It leaves my skin feeling smooth and leaves a cooling effect.

I love how this stuff it makes my face feel in the morning - fresh, new, tingly and ready for what may come. Great for reducing ingrown hairs in beard and hairline. The grit is just right...effective but not harsh. A must have for any routine.
I love this face scrub. It leaves my skin feeling so smooth, refreshed and clean! This scrub has quickly become a vital part of my daily routine!
My boyfriend has this scrub in his shower, so one day I tried it. Feel in love. My face feels super clean afterwards and gives my skin a wake up call. So refreshing.

I start with my favorite scrub for a clean and healthy face. It's the start of a great routine and a treat for my face. I move onto Energizing Face Wash, then Brushless White Eagle Shave Cream and finish with Facial Fuel Moisturizer. A Great Routine for my Face.

I use this facial scrub 2-3 times a week as suggested and the result is healthy skin. Really leaves my face feeling energized and refreshed. This is a basic product that everyone should use regularly.

I struggled with acne my whole life until I started using this. My husband had used it for a long time and one time we took a trip, I forgot my face wash and started using his, never stopped. I love this stuff and I've already recommended it to several people.

At first wash you will immediately feel refresh and skin will feel so light like all the dirt and other impurities are gone. Been using this for only a week but the result is like months my skin got lighter as it looks and some sebum disappear already.

avis.titre: Facial Fuel Scrub is the Best
avis.texte: I use this scrub every morning in the shower. I scrub my whole face, under my chin and even along the sides of my neck with it. It exfoliates my skin enough so my pores don't get clogged up anymore and my skin looks nice and smooth. It helps me from getting ingrown hairs and zits.

avis.titre: Absolute favorite Kiehl's product without a doubt
avis.texte: I love this scrub. It feels so good after use and the coolness really re energizes the skin. Skin feels smoother and softer with continued use, and it's perfect to use before shaving. I can definitely see this product as a life-long purchase.

I tend to try to shave every other day as I have very sensitive skin. I was skeptical of using a scrub because of the sensitivity. Much to my surprise, this does not irritate my skin in any way and is a great product to help with getting the closest shave possible. I start my routine with this and it really tends to get the hair on my face to stand at attention! Follow it up with a good quality shave cream and you good to go. Highly recommend.
I frankly was sceptical about the crushed apricot kernels, but boy do they work. My face feels and looks better after I use this.
Good price point and well worth it. Effective scrub that is strong enough for my oily skin yet not too over drying

they were out of scrubs that I normally use and one of the sales representatives recommended me to try out one of men's collection scrubs that she uses as well. I had my doubts but I decided to try it out and this product is amazing! It leaves my skin so soft and smells minty and refreshing. I have been hooked to this scrub since then so I totally recommend ladies to try out this product!

This is the best product that Kiehl's has to offer HANDS DOWN! I have to admit that I was skeptical at first, but after a few uses, it will be a regularly ordered product. Admittedly, it doesn't look like much when first squeezed out of the tube, but once it was applied to the washcloth it generates a mild lather and it feels great scrubbing over your face. Washes clean with no irritants Highly impressed with this product.

I use a moisturizer that is more like a chemical peel. What this scrub does is finish it off just right. The chemical peels turns the skin over and this scrub comes right in and removes those dead skin cells. Like other Kiehl's products I've tried it just seems to do the job just right. My skin is not left too raw and my skin is super soft after.

I've used Facial Fuel Energizing Scrub for years and never get anything less than superb results. I credit it to a large extent for my skin remaining so youthful at an age when most of my peers have substantial forehead and facial wrinkles. I *love* the feeling of touching my baby-smooth skin after sloughing away all that gross dead skin on my face. Kiehl's has also found the perfect balance between a scrub that scrubs *enough* but not *too* much; some men's scrubs out there are like rubbing sharp pebbles on your face!

This is an amazing scrub. It is gentle enough that I can use it daily without it drying my face out to much. Love the tingle of the menthol. I use this with the rest of the facial fuel line and it works great. Takes a small amount so good value as well.
This is has been a great product by itself and a staple before my shave.

This is a great product -- like almost all of the Kiehl's items. Effectively cleans the surface of the skin, is not so medicated or numbing as the Facial Fuel Shave Cream, and smells great. I had been using the Soy Milk and Honey Body Scrub after shaving, but the Facial Fuel Scrub offers a finer grain, appears to be smoother on the skin, and seems to tighen the pores. Anyway, it's a good item to use 2-3-times a week and to have nearby in the shower. I use it after shaving rather than beforehand ....

My husband loves this stuff. A deep cleaning scrub that works so well it evicted black heads that had been hunkered down in his deep pores since 10th grade. Now his nose doesn't look like a Seurat painting!

avis.titre: Another Hit in the Facial Fuel Line
avis.texte: I use this product every other day to help scrub away dead skin and exfoliate my face. It is very gentle, but still does the job. A little goes a long way. I love this product and now use it to wash my face after a workout at the gym. Try it and you will like it too.

avis.titre: My boyfriend swears by this product!
avis.texte: He doesn't usually bother with skin care products, but he loves this one and the eye cream that goes with it.

avis.titre: It does what it says it will!
avis.texte: Got this for my husband, who uses it 2 times a week, and I have noticed much less ingrown hairs since he started. He loves it too...says it makes his skin feel smooth & that the smell really does wake him up!
I absolutely love using this scrub two to three times a week. It really refreshes my skin and complexion! Not too drying or too harsh either.

avis.titre: Best present I've ever gotten my boyfriend
avis.texte: After helping my boyfriend through his first tube of this amazing scrub, I had to rush out and get him another...that I also used...what can I say, we both love it! The scrubby-beads make your skin feel so smooth and the ingredients and scent are a really refreshing way to start the day. Great product.

This is an incredible scrub. It is gentle,yet thorough with amazing results. My skin is baby soft and glowing after I use it and I use it 2x a week.I am a satisfied customer and will continue to use this wonderful scrub.

Of all the scrubs I've tried this is the scrub that doesn't dry my skin out or make it oily after. I've had oily skin for many years and get 'shiny' as the day goes on but since I've switched to Kiehl's products I can honestly say I don't have this problem any longer. My problem with this is there doesn't seem to enough in the tube! I tend to use quite a bit. Not sure if the packaging could use some changing to better release the product?
